scan_linter_check.description:
Flags field values set by assigning to the field property of current or of a GlideRecord variable (current.state = 3) instead of setValue(). setValue() converts the value for the field type and is the documented API. Informational. Server-side scripts only.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Dot-Walking Instead of getValue/setValue", narrowed to assignments: dot-walked reads are normal and are no longer reported.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-GR-007: Field set by direct assignment
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Use setValue(field, value) (or setDisplayValue for display values) instead of assigning to the field property.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A field value is set with current.field = value instead of setValue().
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-GR-007: Field set by direct assignment
